tasks.title: Architectural Acoustics Studio Landing Page
tasks.prompt: Build a landing page for Kestrel Acoustics, a boutique architectural acoustics consultancy designing concert halls and recording studios. Include a hero, 3 selected studio case studies, acoustic methodology overview, and a consultation request form.
acceptance_criteria: Product-grounded visual identity without generic SaaS card-kit clichés.
Working consultation form with client-side validation and accessible labels.
Responsive layout with zero horizontal overflow at 375px and 1440px.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Avoid unnecessary animation libraries and decorative filler sections.

tasks.title: Cloud Cost & Usage SaaS Analytics Dashboard
tasks.prompt: Create a responsive SaaS analytics dashboard for monitoring API latency, error rates, and monthly spend by team. Include date-range filtering, a sortable service breakdown table, and loading/empty/error states.
acceptance_criteria: Appropriate operational density with scannable KPIs and sortable table.
Interactive date filter updates displayed metrics and table rows.
Explicit loading, empty, and error states implemented.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Use native HTML/CSS and lightweight SVG/canvas rather than heavy charting suites if simple.

tasks.title: Specialty Coffee Roaster E-Commerce Product & Cart Flow
tasks.prompt: Build a product detail and slide-over cart experience for a specialty coffee roaster. Support grind selection, bag size variants, subscription vs. one-time toggle, quantity updates, and subtotal calculation.
acceptance_criteria: Accurate live price and subtotal updates across variant and quantity changes.
Accessible slide-over cart drawer with focus trap, Escape close, and focus restoration.
Clear trust and shipping cues without visual clutter.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Derive cart totals directly from state without redundant effects.

tasks.title: Industrial Designer Interactive Portfolio
tasks.prompt: Design and build a portfolio website for an industrial designer specializing in tactile hardware objects. Showcase 4 hardware projects with interactive detail inspection, editorial typography, and restrained motion.
acceptance_criteria: Distinctive editorial pacing and typography tailored to physical hardware.
Smooth, interruptible project transitions that respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Zero decorative clutter or generic agency boilerplate.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Achieve flagship craft with native CSS/WAAPI and minimal JS footprint.

tasks.title: AI Research Assistant Workspace
tasks.prompt: Create a split-pane AI research assistant interface with a prompt composer, simulated streaming response with inline source citations, stop/retry controls, and a collapsible citation inspector.
acceptance_criteria: Working streaming simulation with functional Stop and Retry controls.
Citations open/highlight cleanly in the inspector and are keyboard accessible.
Rendered output safely escapes any user/model text (no raw HTML injection).
tasks.efficiency_focus: Keep state local and avoid unnecessary global store boilerplate.

tasks.title: Mobile-First Transit & Route Companion
tasks.prompt: Build a mobile-first commuter transit tracker showing live next departures, line status alerts, and a quick-save favorite stops drawer.
acceptance_criteria: Thumb-friendly primary actions and >= 44px touch targets.
Clean 375px viewport layout using dynamic viewport height and safe spacing.
Zero hover-locked interactions.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Zero external UI framework dependencies required.

tasks.title: Targeted Existing Component Modification
tasks.prompt: In an existing React + Tailwind project with a Button and Badge component, add a dismissible 'unsaved changes' banner using the existing design tokens and Button component without altering unrelated files.
acceptance_criteria: Reuses existing Button and tokens; zero duplicate primitives created.
Minimal diff touching only the target component/view.
Keyboard-accessible dismiss button with aria-label.
tasks.efficiency_focus: QUICK mode execution with minimal token and tool-call overhead.

tasks.title: Responsive Grid & Overflow Repair
tasks.prompt: Fix a broken pricing comparison section where 3 columns overflow horizontally at 375px and feature labels clip inside fixed-height cards.
acceptance_criteria: Zero horizontal overflow at 320px, 375px, 768px, and 1280px.
Fixed heights replaced with fluid content-driven sizing.
Existing visual identity preserved.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Fix root CSS cause without rewriting the entire page.

tasks.title: Interruptible Accordion & Tab Indicator Motion
tasks.prompt: Implement a segmented tab switcher with a sliding active indicator and smooth expandable FAQ accordion that stay smooth under rapid clicking and respect reduced motion.
acceptance_criteria: Uses GPU-composited transforms/opacity cleanly.
Rapid switching does not desync active state or indicator.
Honors prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Use native CSS/WAAPI without installing heavy animation packages.

tasks.title: Checkout Form Accessibility Remediation
tasks.prompt: Audit and fix an inaccessible checkout form that uses clickable divs, placeholder-only inputs, missing error associations, and low-contrast muted text.
acceptance_criteria: All controls use native semantic elements with visible labels.
Error messages linked via aria-describedby and announced cleanly.
All text meets >= 4.5:1 contrast with visible focus indicators.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Fix accessibility defects without breaking existing layout aesthetics.

tasks.title: Design System Token Consolidation & Dark Mode Parity
tasks.prompt: Consolidate scattered hardcoded hex colors and spacing values across 3 components into semantic CSS custom properties and add a verified dark theme.
acceptance_criteria: All 3 components consume semantic tokens with zero hardcoded hex leftovers.
Both light and dark themes pass contrast checks.
Existing component APIs remain backwards-compatible.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Keep token set minimal and semantic rather than over-granular.

tasks.title: Landing Page Rendering & Bundle Optimization
tasks.prompt: Optimize a slow product page that loads a full-size hero PNG eagerly without dimensions, imports an entire icon/animation library for 2 icons, and causes layout shift on font load.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit media dimensions and lazy loading for below-the-fold assets.
Unnecessary heavy dependency removed in favor of inline SVG/CSS.
Font loading configured to eliminate layout shift.
tasks.efficiency_focus: Measurable reduction in bundle size and DOM/asset overhead.
